comment: M2-DOCTR-QUAL-PREFLIGHT default quality thresholds (user-directed 2026-09-29). The user text specifies IoU matching; the primary judging layer uses coverage (intersection/gt_area) because docTR word-level output cannot reach IoU 0.5 against block-level GT (granularity mismatch, evidence in verification/M2-DOCTR-QUAL/baseline-summary.md §4). This criterion substitution is a judging-contract deviation from the user-default text and is flagged for the pending qualification ruling; block_strict (true IoU) numbers are always reported alongside.
criterion_note: coverage = intersection/gt_area >= iou_match_threshold; parallel strict layer block_coverage vs block_strict is reported in every result
severe_page_miss_definition: on the primary layer (block_coverage): a region with >= severe_page_miss_min_gt GT boxes and zero matched detections; rate is over regions that contain at least one GT box
